title: CUSTOMS AGENCY LICENSE 2026: ADDENDUM TO THE PUBLIC NOTICE ISSUED ON AUGUST 18, 2025 - Uganda Revenue Authority
text:
# CUSTOMS AGENCY LICENSE 2026: ADDENDUM TO THE PUBLIC NOTICE ISSUED ON AUGUST 18, 2025
Pursuant to Section 145 (1) of the East African Community Customs Management Act, 2004 (as amended) and Regulation 149 – 152 of the East African Community Customs Management Regulations, 2010, the Commissioner Customs of the Uganda Revenue Authority invites applicants for renewal of Customs Agency Licenses for the Year 2026.
Application Form (Form No. C20), Licensing Conditions and Assessment Forms are accessible via https://singlewindow.go.ug/stp/#/
All applicants are advised to ensure that the electronic application is duly completed; all relevant information and documents as indicated on the Electronic Single Windows platform, are availed, scanned and uploaded to https://singlewindow.go.ug/stp/#/ not later than October 01, 2025 .
Authorised Economic Operators (AEO) companies will only be required to submit applications for automatic renewal of their Customs Agency License(s), subject to payment of the requisite fees.
The activities related to licensing will be conducted strictly within timelines below;
ACTIVITY
Receiving Applications and payment of Application fee.
1 st September – 1 st October 2025
Competence Test for Declarants.
27 th October 2025
Vetting applications.
1 st September – 1 st November 2025
Appeals for review
16 th October – 16 th November 2025
Final verification and Payment of License Fee.
1 st September 2025 – 31 st March 2026
Closing date for Issuance of Licenses.
31 st March 2026
First date of Publication: Tuesday September 16, 2025.
Developing Uganda Together
